name: attach
description: Attach an image or file to a node: a screenshot of a web page you captured with your browser or Playwright tools, a diagram, a PDF. Give exactly one of url (the plugin downloads it), file_path (absolute path to a file you saved in your workspace; preferred for screenshots) or base64 (small images only, under about 100 KB, with mime_type). Allowed types: png, jpeg, gif, webp, svg, pdf, txt, md, csv, json; max 10 MB. Add a caption and the source_url of the page it shows.

node_id.description: The node to attach to. Node id (nd_...) or an @ref you set earlier in this run.

url.description: http(s) URL of the file to download.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local file, e.g. a screenshot you just saved.

base64.description: File bytes, base64-encoded. Small files only.

mime_type.description: MIME type, e.g. image/png. Required with base64; otherwise detected.

caption.description: One line saying what it shows.

source_url.description: The page the screenshot or file came from.
